_comment: The torch bearer who hands you the lamp at the start. Read by src/core/Intro.cpp.
character is a rigged glTF or GLB under assets/. animations is an animation library for the
same rig, or leave it out if the character has its own clips.
clips name the clip for each part of the story. Case, dots and underscores do not matter, and a
part of a name is enough. If one is wrong, the gallery prints every clip it has.
hand is the bone the torch is held in, and grip a knuckle bone that puts it in the palm.
give_hold is how far into the give clip to stop, with
the arm held out. walk_speed is in metres a second, set to match the walk.
